cutoff.meaning: The meeting ends at 4:00 PM Eastern Time on 12 March 2026; any votes not cast by then do not count.

negative_condition: Fewer than two members vote to approve, or the required votes are not cast before the meeting ends.
positive_condition: A majority of the three voting members (i.e., at least two) vote to approve the request before the meeting ends.

proof.meaning: The official minutes of the 12 March meeting recording the motion and votes.
proof.name: meeting minutes
proof.subject: committee members

terminal_meaning: The committee's recorded votes under its own majority rule determine approval or denial of the compassionate-use request at the 12 March meeting.
